items.text: UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Phindiselani abantwana bakwa-Israyeli kumaMidiyani; emva kwalokho uyobuthelwa kubantu bakini.
UMose wakhuluma kubantu, wathi: “Hlomelani impi abanye benu, bahambe bahlasele abakwaMidiyani, baphindisele uJehova wakwaMidiyani.”
Kumelwe nithumele impi kuzo zonke izizwe zakwa-Israyeli inkulungwane esizweni ngasinye.
Ezinkulungwaneni zakwa-Israyeli kwakhishwa inkulungwane esizweni, izinkulungwane eziyishumi nambili zihlomele impi.
UMose wabathuma empini, inkulungwane esizweni, bona noFinehasi indodana ka-Eleyazare umpristi, baye empini, bephethe izinto ezingcwele namacilongo okubethwa esandleni sakhe.
Balwa nabakwaMidiyani, njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose; babulala bonke abesilisa.

Babulala amakhosi akwaMidiyani, ngaphandle kwabaseleyo kwababuleweyo; okungukuthi u-Ewi, noRekemi, noSuri, noHure, noReba, amakhosi ayisihlanu akwaMidiyani; UBileyamu indodana kaBeyori naye wababulala ngenkemba.
Abantwana bakwa-Israyeli bathumba bonke abesifazane bakwaMidiyani nabantwana babo, bathumba zonke izinkomo zabo, nayo yonke imihlambi yabo, nayo yonke impahla yabo.
Bayishisa yonke imizi yabo ababehlala kuyo, nezinqaba zabo zonke ezinhle ngomlilo.
Athatha yonke impango nayo yonke impango yabantu neyezilwane.
Baletha abathunjwa, nempango, nempango kuMose, naku-Eleyazare umpristi, nasenhlanganweni yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli ekamu emathafeni akwaMowabi ngaseJordani ngaseJeriko.
OMose no-Eleyazare umpristi nazo zonke izikhulu zenhlangano baphuma ukubahlangabeza ngaphandle kwekamu.
UMose wazithukuthelela izinduna zempi nezinduna zezinkulungwane nezinduna zamakhulu ezazivela empini.
Wayesethi uMose kubo: “Nibaphilise bonke abesifazane na?
Bheka, kwenza abantwana bakwa-Israyeli baphambuka kuJehova endabeni yasePeyori ngesiluleko sikaBileyamu, kwaba khona isifo phakathi kwebandla leNkosi.
Manje bulalani bonke abesilisa phakathi kwabantwana, nibulale wonke owesifazane owazi indoda ngokulala nayo.
Kepha bonke abantwana babesifazane abangayazi indoda ngokulala nayo, zigcineni niphila.

Njalo lizahlala ngaphandle kwenkamba insuku eziyisikhombisa: wonke owabulala umuntu laye wonke othinte ohlutshiweyo, lizazihlambulula ngosuku lwesithathu langosuku lwesikhombisa, lina lezibotshwa zenu.
Uhlanze zonke izingubo zakho, nakho konke okwenziwe ngezikhumba, nakho konke okwenziwe ngoboya bembuzi, nakho konke okwenziwa ngokhuni.
Umpristi u-Eleyazare wayesethi emabuthweni ayephuma impi: “Nakhu ukuqina komthetho uJehova ayala ngawo uMose;
kuphela igolide, nesiliva, nethusi, nensimbi, nethini, nomthofu,
Konke okungabekezelela umlilo niyakukudabula emlilweni, kuhlambuluke; nokho kufanele ihlanzwe ngamanzi okuhlukanisa; futhi bonke labo abangakwazi ukuthwala umlilo, kumelwe nidabule emanzini.
Kumelwe nihlanze izingubo zenu ngosuku lwesikhombisa, niyohlambuluka, ngemva kwalokho ningene ekamu.
UJehova wakhuluma kuMose, wathi:
Bala inani lempango eyathunjwayo, eyabantu neyezilwane, wena no-Eleyazare umpristi nezinhloko zomndeni wenhlangano.
Futhi uhlukanise impango izingxenye ezimbili; phakathi kwalabo abaphuma impi, phakathi kwebandla lonke.
Niyakuthathela uJehova intela emaqhaweni aphuma impi: umphefumulo oyedwa kwabangamakhulu ayisihlanu, kubantu, nakuzo izinkomo, nakuzo izimbongolo, nakuzo izimvu;
Thatha inxenye yazo uyinike u-Eleyazare umpristi ibe ngumnikelo wokuphakanyiswa ovela kuJehova.

Enxenyeni yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli uyakuthatha enye emashumini ayisihlanu, kubantu, nakuzo izinkomo, nakuzo izimbongolo, nasemhlambini wezimvu, kuzo zonke izinhlobo zezilwane, ukunike amaLevi agcina imihlambi isevisi. Wetabernakele leNkosi.
OMose no-Eleyazare umpristi benza-ke njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Impango eyayisele impango amadoda empi ayibambayo yayiyizimvu eziyizinkulungwane ezingamakhulu ayisithupha namashumi ayisikhombisa nanhlanu;
nezinkomo eziyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisithupha nambili,
nezimbongolo eziyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi ayisithupha nanye,
futhi kubo bonke abantu abayizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amathathu nambili kwabesifazane abangayazi indoda ngokulala nayo.
Ingxenye, eyayiyisabelo sabaphuma impi, ngenani, yayiyizimvu eziyizinkulungwane ezingamakhulu amathathu namashumi amathathu nesikhombisa namakhulu amahlanu;
Intela kaJehova ezimvini yayingamakhulu ayisithupha namashumi ayisithupha nanhlanu.
Izinkomo zaziyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amathathu nesithupha; kuzo intela yeNkosi yayingamashumi ayisithupha neshumi nambili.
Izimbongolo yizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amathathu namakhulu amahlanu; kuzo intela kaJehova yayingamashumi ayisithupha nanye.
Abantu babe yizinkulungwane eziyishumi nesithupha; kuzo intela kaJehova yayingabantu abangamashumi amathathu nambili.
UMose wayinika u-Eleyazare umpristi intela, eyayingumnikelo weNkosi, njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Engxenyeni yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli uMose ayihlukanisa namadoda empi,
Ingxenye yebandla yayiyizimvu eziyizinkulungwane ezingamakhulu amathathu namashumi amathathu nesikhombisa namakhulu amahlanu,
nezinkomo eziyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amathathu nesithupha,
izimbongolo eziyizinkulungwane ezingamashumi amathathu namakhulu amahlanu,
Futhi abantu abayizinkulungwane eziyishumi nesithupha;
Enxenyeni yabantwana bakwa-Israyeli uMose wathatha enye emashumini ayisihlanu, kubantu nasezilwaneni, wayinika amaLevi agcina inkonzo yetende likaJehova; njengalokho uJehova emyalile uMose.
Izinduna zezinkulungwane zebutho, izinduna zezinkulungwane lezinduna zamakhulu zasondela kuMozisi.
Base bethi kuMose: “Izinceku zakho zibalile amadoda empi ayephansi kwesandla sethu, akwasilelanga neyodwa kithi.”

Ngakho saletha umnikelo womlilo kuJehova abawutholayo, kwaba yilowo nalowo, izinto zegolide, namaketanga, namasongo, namasongo, namacici, nezibhebhe, ukwenzela imiphefumulo yethu ukubuyisana phambi kukaJehova.
OMose no-Eleyazare umpristi bathatha kubo igolide, yonke impahla eyenziwe.
Lonke igolide lomnikelo abawuletha kuJehova, lezikhulu zenkulungwane nelezinduna zekhulu, lalingamashekeli ayizinkulungwane eziyishumi nesithupha namakhulu ayisikhombisa namashumi ayisihlanu.
(Ngokuba amadoda empi athatha impango, kwaba yilowo nalowo ngeyakhe.)
OMose no-Eleyazare umpristi bathatha igolide lezinduna zezinkulungwane nezamakhulu, balingenisa etendeni lokuhlangana ukuba bakhumbule abantwana bakwa-Israyeli phambi kukaJehova.
